newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Secretary General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Monday refuted the allegation by the government that the party was involved in subversive activities.
Bangladesh's private jute mill owners have said they are losing 50 percent production due to power cuts.
South African President Nelson Mandela, Turkish President Suleyman Demirel and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat arrive in Dhaka on Tuesday to attend the independence day celebration on Wednesday.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) will announce its next programme of movement on March 30.
The student wing of opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) swept Monday's student union elections of the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET).
The government has finalised all arrangements for repatriation of 6,700 tribal refugees from camps in India in the first phase.
The Power Development Board (PDB) has decided to replace Chinese technicians by Russian experts to speed up the installation work of the 210 megawatt sixth unit of the Ghorasal Power Plant complex.
The government is likely to downsize this year's development programme in view of the fall in revenue earnings and other receipts. REUTER
